facts.fact: The ICT ministry's sector strategy of February 2021 states that about a hundred public institutions are interconnected by a fibre-optic link and that the project needs to be extended to the communes and other public institutions not yet connected; no commune is said to be on it.

The sector strategy for implementing the National Development Plan 2018-2027, issued by the Ministry of Communication, Information Technologies and Media in February 2021, names the extension of the government's fibre-optic interconnection to the communes under its e-government project.
